## LEDGER

**RETAINED[]** (areas kept at 0.3, with verdict)

| area | verdict |
|---|---|
| `packages/features/` | rap_sheet + blueprint place booking orchestration, workflows, payments, profile here; owns the branding resolver |
| `packages/emails/` | renders the confirmation/reminder/verification messages named in the query |
| `packages/trpc/` | booking confirm/reject and the verification-code send route live here |
| `packages/app-store/` | payment adapters (stripe/paypal) run the post-payment path |
| `apps/web/` | the booking page that the query says already respects the flag |
| `packages/lib/` | CalendarEvent builder / shared helpers on the path |
| `packages/prisma/` | persists `hideBranding` on user/team/org |
| `apps/api/v2/` + `packages/platform/` | platform adapters expose the same flag (sibling-set risk per 4.2) |
| `packages/sms/` | SMS delivery of reminder/verification messages |
| `packages/types/` | `CalendarEvent` declaration the flag would travel on |

**DROPPED[]**: `companion/*`, `apps/ai`, `packages/embeds/*`, `packages/config`, `packages/tsconfig`, `packages/kysely`, `packages/dayjs`, `.agents/.claude/agents` — blueprint/rap_sheet place these as device shells, build config, tooling or date maths; none renders or resolves branding. (`packages/embeds` was checked at the ladder: its only `branding` token is `EmbedNonStylesConfig.branding.brandColor`, a colour, not the vendor mark.)

**Obligations**

| id | phrase | status | closers |
|---|---|---|---|
| OB1 | branding still on confirmation + reminder messages | CLOSED | `RegularBookingService.ts`, `handleConfirmation.ts`, `scheduleEmailReminders.ts`, `reminderScheduler.ts`, `emailReminderManager.ts`, `EmailWorkflowService.ts`, `handleBookingRequested.ts`, `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `confirm.handler.ts`, `handleMarkNoShow.ts` |
| OB2 | booking page respects it (correct side) | CLOSED | `bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx`, `payment.tsx`, `hideBranding.ts` |
| OB3 | code-verification message before a booking | CLOSED | `sendVerifyEmailCode.handler.ts`, `sendVerifyEmailCode.schema.ts`, `verifyEmail.ts`, `useVerifyEmail.ts` |
| OB4 | after a paid booking goes through | CLOSED | `handlePaymentSuccess.ts`, `payment/getBooking.ts` |
| OB5 | team event vs member's own event disagree | CLOSED | `hideBranding.ts`, `scheduleEmailReminders.ts:519-535`, `getEventTypesFromDB.ts`, `TeamRepository.ts`, `UserRepository.ts` |

**Counts**: |SEEN| 190+ · |CONFIRMED| 25 · |RULED_OUT| 13 (email templates/components bulk-searched verbatim: no branding flag consumed) · |CANDIDATES| ~40 · answer = 65

{"contract":"Whenever Cal.com decides whether to show its own name/logo on anything an attendee sees for a given event, that decision must come from one resolver that considers the whole ownership chain — team → parent organization for team events, and user → organization profile for a personal event (packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-181) — so that every outbound surface for the same event agrees. Any call site that instead reads a single denormalized field (typically eventType.owner.hideBranding, or team.hideBranding OR user.hideBranding without the org parent), or that omits the flag entirely, breaks the contract: it silently returns false for team-owned events (whose eventType has no owner) and for org-inherited settings, re-branding confirmation/reminder emails and SMS, the pre-booking verification code message, and the post-payment notifications that the paid white-label plan is supposed to strip.","defect_location":{"repo":"calcom/cal.com","summary":"The correct contract is packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-181 (resolveHideBranding at :35-45 lets an organization setting override the entity, shouldHideBrandingForEvent at :116-153 branches team-vs-user, wrappers at :158-181). The booking page and payment page honour it — apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:13,251-255 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:6,58-60 — which is why the page people book on is right. The notification paths do not. packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2620,2804,2819 passes hideBranding: !!eventType.owner?.hideBranding || !!platformClientId into workflow/reminder scheduling; the same owner-only expression appears at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:458,471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:103, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:464, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:567, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:404, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:669 (and a hard-coded hideBranding: true at :602), and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:186. For a team event eventType.owner is null, so the expression is false and the mark reappears — exactly the team-vs-personal divergence reported. The paid-booking path repeats it at packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:231 (BOOKING_PAID trigger), fed by the owner-only Prisma selection in packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:38-42. A second, independent resolver exists at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:519-535 — return !!booking.eventType.team.hideBranding for team bookings else !!booking.user?.hideBranding — which never consults the parent organization, and it feeds every reminder render at :246,272,300,433 via isBrandingDisabled. That flag then flows through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:53,93,159,213,248,262,267,280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,117,151,189,211, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,38,82 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:97,241,453,468,554 — the last of which already does it correctly via getHideBranding (EmailWorkflowService.ts:8,251-269), as does packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:11,133-145, which is the in-repo proof that the shared resolver is the intended source. The pre-booking verification code carries no branding flag at all: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.handler.ts:33-38 forwards only email/username/language/isVerifyingEmail to packages/features/auth/lib/verifyEmail.ts:88-93, with the input contract at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.schema.ts and the caller at apps/web/modules/bookings/hooks/useVerifyEmail.ts:31,55-59 — so the vendor mark is unconditional there.
